settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_OUTPUT_DIR
settings.label: Folder for finished documents
settings.help: Where your invoices and other documents are saved, sorted by year and month. Nothing in it is ever replaced.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_INPUT_DIRS
settings.label: Folders with your own templates
settings.help: Only needed when you use your own templates, logo or letterhead: the folders they are in. The ready-made invoice works without it.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_FONTS
settings.label: Extra fonts
settings.help: Only needed for writing such as Chinese, Japanese, Korean or Thai: font files that have those characters.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_MAX_PAGES
settings.label: Most pages in one document
settings.help: A document with more pages than this is not created.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_MAX_FORM_FIELDS
settings.label: Most boxes in one PDF form
settings.help: A PDF form with more boxes to fill in than this is not opened. The largest official forms have about 6000.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_MAX_INPUT_BYTES
settings.label: Largest template file (bytes)
settings.help: A template, logo or letterhead larger than this is not read. The usual limit is 20 MB.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
settings.label: Largest finished document (bytes)
settings.help: A document larger than this is not saved. The usual limit is 50 MB.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.label: Longest time for one document (milliseconds)
settings.help: Creating a document is stopped when it takes longer than this. The usual limit is one minute.

settings.name: DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES_MAX_MEMORY_MB
settings.label: Most memory for one document (MB)
settings.help: Creating a document is stopped when it needs more memory than this.
